subtitle: Meeting notes your AI writes up from rough notes or transcripts.
about: A note with meeting summaries, decisions and an action checklist with owners and due dates. Give your AI rough notes or a transcript to write it up, then tick off tasks yourself or in chat.

ask.prompt: Set up the meeting notes template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: Write up a meeting
slides.you: Thursday's pricing sync: keep the three plans, drop the lifetime deal, yearly discount to 15%. Sara sends prices to sales by Wednesday.
slides.ai: Added Pricing sync, 19 November, and two action items.
slides.alt: The pricing sync written up, with action items

slides.label: Days later, ask
slides.you: What did we agree with Sara on Thursday?
slides.ai: Keep the three plans, drop the lifetime deal, yearly discount to 15%. Sara sends the new prices to sales by 25 Nov.
slides.alt: Action items and the pricing sync, in Meeting notes

slides.label: Use it yourself
slides.note: Or tick and edit it yourself.
slides.alt: Meeting notes as it starts, ready to fill in
